notes.title: Raid on Taihoku - Update v1.0.4.3
notes.content:
Dear player,

Thank you for playing "Raid on Taihoku." We have been working hard and continuously collecting feedback from players in order to make the game more polished and enjoyable. The content of this update is as follows:

Optimizations:


Added a button in the safe zone of levels to activate the running function (keyboard/mouse/gamepad).


Updated the layout of the operation page and added running instructions.


Split some longer dialogues that cannot be skipped into two sentences to facilitate player information reading.

Fixes:


Fixed the issue with automatic detection of Simplified Chinese language causing problems. Simplified Chinese language will now display correctly when playing the game.


Fixed the issue with the "The Real Kuro" side mission where players couldn't interact with the cat correctly.


Fixed the problem of seeing NPCs disappear due to the updated running content.


Fixed the problem of characters being stuck/unable to walk due to the updated running content.

We hope that these adjustments can enhance your gaming experience. "Raid on Taihoku" is currently on sale, with a 20% discount till 4/8.

If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact our team or fill out our bug report form, and we will be happy to assist you.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfaF15YgthsFtcO9z18GPMIP947mBrzlbZNGPPETVjfpOh8EA/viewform

We wish you a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Raid on Taihoku - Update v1.0.3.5
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you for your support in Raid on Taihoku. We have been continuously working hard and committed to making the game better and more interesting. The contents of this update are as follows:

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Optimize the scene textures and lighting effects of Taihoku Station.
[*] Improve the end credits video by reducing camera shake and optimizing objects.
[*] Optimize the objects and lighting effects of the Taiwan Shrine.
[*] Optimize the scene objects of Sakaechō Street.
[/olist]
[h3]Corrections[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Fix issues caused by joystick operation.
[*] Fix issues caused when controlling Kuro.
[*] Fix issues caused when operating the umbrella.
[*] Correct errors in the description text of the collection book.
[*] Fix issues with the generation of patrols in the level.
[*] Fix grammatical issues in the English language version.
[*] Fix the problem of the player character not generating correctly.
[*] Fix the problem of the achievement "You are the best player!" not being achievable.
[*] Fix the problem of translation errors in the memory video.
[/olist]
[h3]New Content[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Add Simplified Chinese language support and the ability to switch languages.
[/olist]
We hope these adjustments will enhance your gaming experience. If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact our development team or fill out a bug report form to assist us. We will be happy to assist you. 

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfaF15YgthsFtcO9z18GPMIP947mBrzlbZNGPPETVjfpOh8EA/viewform 

Have a great time playing!

notes.title: 1.1 Demo Version Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your valuable feedback after playing the “Raid on Taihoku” game demo. We listened to your feedback and have discussed it. The game demo has been updated with :

1. Optimized game performance
2. New game scene elements
3. Fixed problem of getting stuck while model glitching
4. Temporarily removed keyboard controls

We hope that these improvements create an enjoyable gaming experience for you. If you have any thoughts or suggestions, let us know what you think [url=https://forms.gle/tw4TiVmGSvHAeA6G8]here[/url]. We really appreciate your feedback and are looking forward to hearing more future feedback from you in the future.
